question: Dance couple Kamalini and Nalini Asthana have been awarded the Padma Shri in 2022. He is famous for which of the following dance styles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kamalini Asthana and Nalini Asthana**, hailing from **Agra, Uttar Pradesh,** form a celebrated sister duo renowned for their exceptional performances in the **Benaras Gharana style of Kathak.**
 
• Their dedication to promoting this style both within India and internationally has earned them widespread acclaim.
 
• Their inaugural overseas journey occurred in 1983 when they participated in the **UFTAA Conference in Paris, France.**
 
• Initially planned for a mere two weeks, their tour extended unexpectedly for nearly two and a half years.
 
• Throughout this extensive excursion, they mesmerized audiences with their Kathak performances in various international locales, including Torremolinos and Madrid in Spain, Dublin in Ireland, and the ISKCON in London.
 
• Kamalini and Nalini achieved a remarkable feat by showcasing their talent at the staggering altitude of 18,000 feet at Kailash Mansarovar and Badri Nath.
 
• Their remarkable contributions to the realm of art were duly recognized by the Government of India in 2022 when they were honored with the prestigious Padma Shri award, a testament to their distinguished service in the field of Kathak.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Kathak, o**ne of the eight principal forms of Indian classical dance, traces its origins to the itinerant bards of ancient northern India, known as** Kathakars or storytellers**.
 
• The term "Kathak" is derived from the Sanskrit word **"Katha," meaning "story," and "Kathakar,"** which translates to "the one who tells a story" or "related to stories."
 
• Kathak is synonymous with the art of storytelling, encompassing intricate footwork, graceful movements, and emotive expressions.
 
• Primarily prevalent in northern India, Kathak holds historical significance akin to Bharatanatyam in the south and Odissi in the east, alongside other prominent classical dance forms across South Asia.
